[{"insert":"Strict Pull Up

Your pulling strength runs as a mechanical drop set this cycle, so the back keeps working after your hardest position fatigues. Start with pronated strict pull ups at a 21X1 tempo, using only the assistance you need to hit the reps clean, then move into the DB gorilla row once your overhand grip is spent. Reps on the pull up sit at eight this week, a step heavier than Week 2, so make each pull reach the same height and control the lower on every rep. Stay strict with no kip and keep your shoulder blades pulling down and back.
"}]
